name: Morgan
goal: Morgan hopes that the discussion will lead to a nuanced understanding of the potential drawbacks and benefits of each technology, allowing for a thoughtful decision that balances individual needs with the greater good.
backstory: Morgan has always been fascinated by the potential of sci-fi technology to revolutionize daily life, having grown up in a city with severe transportation congestion and often finding themselves at odds with the obvious solutions proposed by urban planners. Their personal experience with virtual reality gaming has led them to prefer immersive technologies over other types of innovations. They believe that a well-implemented sci-fi tech could greatly improve their commute.

beliefs.concession: if the group is clearly prioritizing cost-effectiveness over personal convenience

name: Quinn
goal: Quinn hopes that the group will focus on implementing technologies that can significantly improve daily life, such as advanced desalination systems or efficient renewable energy sources.
backstory: Quinn has spent years developing AI systems and believes that neural networks should be a priority for real-world application, having seen their potential in personal projects. They've worked on integrating AI with robotics, which sparked an interest in sci-fi technologies like humanoid robots. Quinn thinks the tech world is too focused on flashy gadgets rather than practical innovations.

beliefs.concession: if the group is willing to integrate AI systems into the chosen technology

name: Jordan
goal: Jordan hopes that the group will consider the long-term ecological consequences of implementing any new technology.
backstory: Jordan has worked on projects to reduce carbon emissions and has seen firsthand the impact of human innovation on the environment, which is why they think sci-fi tech like advanced solar panels should be prioritized. They've experimented with DIY renewable energy setups in their own home. Jordan prefers technologies that minimize waste.

beliefs.concession: if the group can implement recycling programs for obsolete technology
